messages:
maria: Quick check — we need a final pass on the three public pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private) before the Tuesday push. Can we lock voice + CTAs today?

kyle: I can do Hosted API hero + subhead. Thinking: make latency claim concrete but conservative. e.g., 'low-latency responses for interactive apps' + a micro-benchmark in the section, not the hero.

liz: For Dedicated, emphasize predictable capacity and SLA language. Also call out autoscaling/bursting as a single line benefit.

sam: Private page should lead with control & compliance — VPC, KMS, and on-prem options. Short bullets > long paragraphs.

maria: Agreed. Also want one unified sentence that differentiates the three modes: "Same API, different operational guarantees" — thoughts?

kyle: That sentence works but make it less engineering-y for product readers: "One API. Pick the environment that fits your needs."

nora: For CTAs: Hosted -> "Try the API" with free credits. Dedicated -> "Get capacity quote". Private -> "Contact solutions". Should we add a webinar CTA cross-link?

liz: Yes please. We have the webinar on 'Serving LLMs at scale' next week — add a small banner on Dedicated and Private pages: "Register to see performance & compliance demos".

maria: On launch posts and benchmark narratives: Don’t promise a single number in hero. Instead add a benchmark card in the middle: e.g., "typical p95 < 120ms on short convo patterns" and a link to full benchmark blog. Keeps hero clean.

sam: Inbound lead routing note — Hosted signups should go to self-serve pipeline (growth). Dedicated & Private leads -> sales/solutions queue with tags: "capacity" or "compliance". Nora can we add those tags in HubSpot?

nora: Yep — will create properties and two routing rules: Hosted -> Growth Slack + CRM; Dedicated/Private -> AE queue + solutions-team. ETA EOD.

copybot: Draft suggestions: Hosted hero — "Get started in minutes with our hosted API." Dedicated headline — "Predictable throughput for mission-critical apps." Private headline — "Control, compliant deployments in your network."

kyle: Nice. I'll post a first pass for the three hero lines in the doc within the hour. Maria, can you review tone after that?

maria: Yep. After Kyle posts, I'll do a quick sweep for consistency with webinar & benchmark references. Then finalize CTAs.

liz: I'll update the Dedicated bullets and add the webinar banner mock.

sam: I'll compress Private copy into 3 bullets and ping infra for exact KMS wording.

nora: Routing rules created. I'll add the HubSpot links in the doc once Kyle's hero pass is up.

maria: Great. Goal: final copy + assets in doc by 5pm PT so dev can slot it for Tuesday release. :thumbsup:

copybot: Checklist created in the doc: heroes, subheads, 3 bullets per page, CTA mapping, benchmark card copy, webinar banner, HQ routing rules.

maria: Perfect — thanks team. Close loop once the doc is live."
